description.value: Lighthouse Indian Kitchen is a northern Indian cuisine chain founded in 2003, specializing in dishes made to order from fresh ingredients and a house blend of 11 authentic Indian spices. The 96th Avenue location operates primarily as a takeout restaurant, offering a wide range of chicken, fish, and vegetarian dishes including pakoras, tikkas, curries, and paneer specialties. It is one of several franchise locations in the Surrey and Langley corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the 96th Ave location at #12815A—96 Ave, Surrey, BC V3V 6V9 with phone 604-583-9958, matching OSM tags. The franchise page explicitly states all non-Cloverdale locations operate as a 'take-out model,' and the menu includes a dedicated 'Veggie Delicacies' section with paneer dishes. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM metadata community field says 'Richmond' but the website and address (12815 96 Ave, V3V 6V9) clearly place this location in Surrey, BC. OSM community tag should be corrected.

Website locations page lists two different addresses for the '96th Ave' location in different parts of the same page: '#12815A—96 Ave, Surrey, BC V3V 6V9' and '9631 128 St, Surrey V3T2X8'. The OSM address matches the first listing; the second may be a data entry error on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating takeout restaurant with a confirmed address and phone. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Veggie Delicacies' section: Chilli Paneer, Paneer Tikka, Shahi Paneer, Karahi Paneer, Manchurian, Cheese Fingers, Spicy Potato Chips. No vegan or GF claims made
